Named borrow returns use a LENGTH observation followed by ordinary cleanup and a usize return; direct forwarding uses compatible CALL proxies. Ordinary expressions cannot consume those proxies. The internal Program is never executed.

Origin reconstruction follows exact rootless formal anchors and selected callee actual arguments; it rejects local/by-value/temporary owned roots, type/mode mismatches, inconsistent returns, suspended parents and unsupported forms. Every emitted return is checked, conservatively including constant-condition arms.
